fields.title: TUNEPS tender ('Appel d'offres') record
fields.description: One record per Tunisian public tender from TUNEPS's public portal, produced by mode=list (a sparse ~10-field summary row) or mode=detail (a rich ~90-field object for one bid id). Every field TUNEPS's own API returns for the record is passed through verbatim, including trilingual coded-value labels: most fields ending in a raw code (e.g. 'procedureType') have companion '<field>StrFr'/'<field>StrAr'/'<field>StrEn' fields carrying the human-readable French/Arabic/English label for that code. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a tender can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:openOnly=<bool>,keyword=<value>'. For detail records: the bid id that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-portail-bid-master-list, S1-portail-bid-master-detail, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

epBidMasterId.title: Bid id
epBidMasterId.description: TUNEPS's internal numeric identifier for this tender -- stable across list and detail, used as the 'detail' mode input.

bidNo.title: Tender reference number
bidNo.description: TUNEPS's own reference number for this tender.

refNo.title: Buyer's reference number
refNo.description: The procuring entity's own internal reference for this tender (detail only).

bidModSeq.title: Modification sequence
bidModSeq.description: Revision counter for this tender ('00' = original publication).

bidInstNm.title: Procuring institution
bidInstNm.description: Name of the government buyer/institution running this tender.

bidInstCd.title: Procuring institution code
bidInstCd.description: TUNEPS's internal code for the procuring institution (detail only).

instRegNo.title: Institution registration number
instRegNo.description: The procuring institution's registration number (detail only).

bidNmEn.title: Tender title (English)
bidNmEn.description: The tender's title/description as published in the English-labeled field -- in practice often identical to the French or Arabic text depending on which language the buyer originally submitted in.

publicDt.title: Published at
publicDt.description: Timestamp when this tender was published to the public portal (SQL-style 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff', not ISO 8601).

publicYn.title: Published flag
publicYn.description: 'Y' if published to the public portal (this actor only ever returns 'Y' records).

bdRecvStartDt.title: Submission opens
bdRecvStartDt.description: When bid submission opens (detail only; SQL-style timestamp).

bdRecvEndDt.title: Submission deadline
bdRecvEndDt.description: Bid submission deadline (SQL-style timestamp) -- used for the 'openOnly' list filter.

bidExpiredDays.title: Bid validity (days)
bidExpiredDays.description: How many days submitted bids must remain valid for (detail only).

procedureType.title: Procedure type (code)
procedureType.description: Coded procurement procedure type; see procedureTypeStrFr/Ar/En for the label (detail only).

bizKindStrFr.title: Business kind (French)
bizKindStrFr.description: e.g. "Fournitures des biens" (supply of goods), "Travaux" (works), "Services" (detail only).

priceTypeStrFr.title: Price type (French)
priceTypeStrFr.description: e.g. "Marché à prix unitaire" (unit-price contract) (detail only).

internationalBidYnStrFr.title: International bid scope (French)
internationalBidYnStrFr.description: e.g. "Appel d'offres national" (national) vs. international tender scope (detail only).

onOffTypeStrFr.title: Submission channel (French)
onOffTypeStrFr.description: "En ligne" (online, via TUNEPS) vs. offline submission (detail only).

executionPlaceStrFr.title: Execution place (French)
executionPlaceStrFr.description: Governorate/region where the contract will be executed (detail only).

frameworkYn.title: Framework agreement flag
frameworkYn.description: 'Y' if this is a framework/marché-cadre agreement (detail only).

consorYnStrFr.title: Consortium bids allowed (French)
consorYnStrFr.description: Whether bidding consortia are permitted (detail only).

biddingDocPrice.title: Bidding document price
biddingDocPrice.description: Cost to obtain the bidding/tender document, if any (detail only).

staffNm.title: Contact staff name
staffNm.description: Named contact person at the procuring institution (detail only).

bdRecvAddrsFr.title: Submission address (French)
bdRecvAddrsFr.description: Physical address for bid submission (detail only).

bdDepartFr.title: Department (French)
bdDepartFr.description: Department within the procuring institution handling this tender (detail only).

hasAnnonce.title: Has announcement
hasAnnonce.description: 'Y'/'N' flag for an associated announcement/corrigendum (detail only).

regId.title: Registration id
regId.description: TUNEPS registration identifier for the procuring institution (detail only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
